name: Radius Recycling
desc: US metals recycler operating scrap processing yards, Pick-n-Pull self-service auto recycling sites and an electric arc furnace steel mill.
products: recycled ferrous and non-ferrous metal, used auto parts, finished steel
customers: steel mills and foundries; retail auto parts buyers at Pick-n-Pull
markets: United States (metals recycling, Pick-n-Pull locations, Oregon steel mill); scrap export customers not detailed on pages opened

fin.value_orig: about $1.3 billion (acquisition by Toyota Tsusho America, July 2025)

signals.what: Acquired by Toyota Tsusho America for about $1.3bn; became wholly owned subsidiary and delisted from Nasdaq
Marc Hathhorn became CEO, succeeding Tamara Lundgren

fit_rationale: US scrap and steel business now inside Toyota Tsusho; Pick-n-Pull is a domestic consumer brand, and only the three US races match, so fit is weak despite scale.

access.roles: CEO; head of marketing and communications

compliance: Wikipedia notes a 2007 SEC FCPA charge against a former chairman (historic).
outstanding: Current revenue not found on an opened page (stockanalysis page mixed data with Radius Health); facility count and export markets to verify.
